mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest quintile (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 3-month moving averages indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS are below 3-month moving averages (t-test p>0.05) or interaction term Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market weakness reducing consumer spending and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 6-month moving average indicates supply chain disruption and economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below 6-month moving average (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) forces Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth is above 50th percentile (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signal stagflationary pressure, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.3pp change in 3 months and UNRATE > 0.2pp change in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise by thresholds (t-test p>0.05) or interaction term Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.
